key_points: Hashgraph Group listed its AI-agent identity platform on IBM Cloud Catalog and signed a global partnership.
IBM and NASA released an open Lunar Foundation Model; IBM, Lockheed Martin, and ETH Zurich launched a quantum innovation hub.
Annual recurring revenue kept growing through a weak quarter, showing business resilience.
Motley Fool highlighted IBM as a top quantum computing stock for long-term holding.
IBM shares slipped ~0.25% twice on quarterly risk concerns, indicating modest short-term pressure.
